title: Celestin band personnel and singers on records
summary: Russell asks about trombonist August Russel, second cornet players, Ricard, and the singers on the records, including Ferdinand and Charles Gills.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: And did you know August Russel? Russel?
August Russel was a trombone player whom I was trying to remember as being a part of the early band when I first joined. He was a trombone at that time. August Russel, yeah.
And what about the cornet player, Russelistan? Who was playing the second cornet?

When he had a big band is when he had the second cornet. That was Guy Kelly. But he didn't have a second cornet, I don't think. I can't recall him having a second cornet with a first band, I generally.
Did you ever play with Ricard and some of the songs?
Ricard played, I think I did, but I can't recall too clearly. I think I did at one time. It seems like he was playing bass, but maybe not. He might have been playing trumpet.
Well I know there are two cornets on its jam up, you know, Celestan and one other. And I didn't know.
Well I don't know who it was.
You don't remember who they were. You haven't heard the records. It could be Ricard, it could be Guy Kelly.
It might have been. I doubt if it was Guy Kelly because he hadn't come in the picture then. He hadn't. He joined in when he had the big band. So it wasn't Guy Kelly, it might have been Ricard.
You know, he had various singers, men that would sing on the records too.
Does Charny sing on, Papa's Got the Jim Jams? I think he's supposed to sing on one of them, yeah. And then Frog's brother, what's his name, Ferdinand Joseph?
Well Ferdinand sang on one, yeah. And then there was another fella, Charlie, somebody who sang on another.
Charles Gills. Yeah. Charles Gills. Yeah.
